mechanism: Estradiol may inhibit mycophenolate glucuronidation, potentially increasing mycophenolate exposure and immunosuppressive effects; mycophenolate may also reduce estradiol efficacy through enterohepatic circulation interference.
action: Monitor for signs of mycophenolate toxicity (GI symptoms, bone marrow suppression); consider alternative contraception or increased mycophenolate monitoring; counsel on potential reduced contraceptive efficacy.
